name: Monster Breach - Pipeline Defense
description: 🧙‍♂️ Build real Fabric Data Pipelines to defeat the Corruption Horde. Four monsters each guard two data defects; clean the crystals to defeat them, then face the Corruption King in a mega-pipeline that combines every technique.
learning_objectives: Build Copy, Dataflow Gen2, Lookup, ForEach, If, Switch and Retry activities
Orchestrate multi-activity pipelines with error handling
Use Lakehouse as pipeline source and sink
Track real-time progress via Eventhouse + KQL dashboard
Validate pipeline output against expected results

items.name: MonsterBreach_LH
items.description: Holds dirty_crystals (input), clean_expected (oracle), and player output tables

items.name: MonsterBreach_EH
items.description: Telemetry for level completions, monsters slain, scores

items.name: MonsterBreach_Seed
items.description: Generates synthetic dirty + expected datasets for all 5 levels

items.name: MonsterBreach_Dashboard
items.description: KQL/Plotly dashboard: boss HP, crystals saved, leaderboard

items.name: Lvl01_CopyQuest
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds Copy Activity + schema cast (drop NULL ids, cast Weight/Purity)

items.name: Lvl02_FilterFortress
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds Distinct + latest-batch filter

items.name: Lvl03_BranchLair
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds If Condition + Switch (Status=Valid, drop Grade F)

items.name: Lvl04_ForEachReef
items.description: Empty pipeline — player adds ForEach + parameters + Retry policy (Weight>0)

items.name: BossBattle_CorruptionKing
items.description: Empty mega-pipeline — player orchestrates ALL techniques (Lookup + ForEach + Copy/Dataflow + filters + Distinct) in one flow

post_deploy_steps: Run MonsterBreach_Seed notebook once to populate dirty_crystals + clean_expected tables
Open MonsterBreach_Judge notebook and read the Level 1 briefing
Open Lvl01_CopyQuest pipeline in Fabric UI and build it as instructed
Run the pipeline, then run judge.check_level(1) in the notebook
Watch MonsterBreach_Dashboard update with your progress
Advance through all 4 levels, then face the Corruption King in BossBattle_CorruptionKing
